name: Comfy Plushpals! — The COZY raising simulator RPG — (with Rizz ✨😏✨)
detailed_description:
Comfy Plushpals! — The Cozy Raising Simulator RPG — (with Rizz ✨😏✨)

Created by ⚾42 in Godot 4.2 stable + Blender 4.2

Welcome to Comfy Plushpals! The ultimate comfort game where you Raise & Rizz — care for adorable plush toys, engage in graffiti / hip hop, and charm your way through a heartwarming world with ✨social stat shenanigans✨.

📝Story overview:

Beyond the fabric of reality exists a care home for Plushpals home to the 🌟

of this story,

(your new playtime pal).

"don't panic." after waking up in Room 42 with amnesia Cozy no longer knows how to take care of himself, it is now your job as the adopter (you) 🫵🏿 to teach and raise him through

self-care or self-harm

In this emotionally grounded, soft-edged life sim RPG, you’ll care for lovable plush characters while learning how to care for yourself. Confront past trauma, build routines that promote self-love, and gently explore sensitive themes like self-harm and mental health with

HP (health points) and MHP (mental health points)—with safety, warmth, and compassion always at the core. 

🧵Features:

✨😏✨  Rizz system
Use your Rizz Stat in social situations. Make friends, flirt (yes, even in a cozy game), or just vibe your way through conversations. 🎲roll for Rizz and try and succeed in ✨Rizz checks✨.

😏 Boost your charisma stat and charm other plushies and NPCs

💌 Experience L Rizz, V Rizz, and the legendary W Rizz outcomes

💳 An in-game Rizz Credit Card™ system for shopping and flexing

Rizz meaning: Slang short for “charisma,” it simply means an ability to charm and woo a person.

Oxford University Press defines “Rizz” as “a person’s ability to attract another person through style, charm, or attractiveness” (with great Rizz comes great Rizzponsibility).

~ the word of the year 2023

📌🍅📱Pincushion Pet Device
Interact with your plushpal via a Virtual pet device modeled after a vintage sewing pincushion. Monitor their needs, emotions, and mood swings through tactile, lo-fi digital buttons.

🧠 Self-care & self-harm mental health mechanics

The game features two health systems: HP (physical health) and MHP (mental health).

Maintain both through routines like hygiene, meals, and relaxing, while learning to

take care of yourself and choosing healthy coping strategies.

🪡 Sewing + graffiti/hip-hop inspired crafting

Customize your world with cozy handmade gear and bold street-style flair. Stitch plush creations, remix patterns, and tag your world with expressive graffiti-inspired art tools.

🌈Hand-crafted retro-style inspired lowpoly visuals

Immerse yourself in cozy, nostalgic environments rendered with vibrant lowpoly textures and chunky retro 3D charm— inspired by retro aesthetics but reimagined through a modern lens.

🎵 A lo-fi comfy soundtrack with plushy beats

Kick back to a cozy blend of lo-fi hip hop soft bass boosted music, BOOM BAP drums, warm vinyl old school retro textures, and plushy melodies that stitch perfectly into the game’s snug, emotional vibe.

also featuring music from legendary hip hop artists such as:

🧶Crafted With Care

Solo-developed by ⚾️42 using Godot 4.2 (Stable) and Blender 4.2, Comfy Plushpals! blends cozycore, emotional storytelling, soft low poly aesthetics, and ✨Rizz✨ all into one surreal, comforting experience.

Thank you! Goodbye!!

Raise and Rizz.™

Wishlist now and prepare for maximum coziness.
Built with love in Godot 4.2 stable and Blender 4.2 by ⚾42.

content_descriptors.notes:
PLEASE BEWARE:
The game contains themes of SELF-HARM both mechanically and narratively though this is also contrasted with themes and mechanics of SELF-CARE alongside it.

Contains the following themes: mental health through both HP (health points) and MHP (mental health points).
The game also explores topics such as trauma.
